name: trykker
description: Foundry: Sorkin Type Co Trykker is a high contrast serifed text face. Trykker has a pleasant old fashioned elegance derived from on 16th century text faces. Trykker can be used from small sizes to larger display settings. Source files are available from Google Code . To contribute to the project contact Eben Sorkin .
